title: Strixwolf Mother
kicker: a huge owl-faced wolf mother guarding her pups near the wreck
hook: a huge owl-faced wolf mother guarding her pups near the wreck

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: A huge owl-wolf mother crouches around her pups, barred feathers and fur bristling, amber eyes fixed on any hand that comes too close.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: Low, protective, ready to retreat if retreat becomes safer than warning.

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: A sudden rush toward the pups, fire, and cornered noise.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
